_note: Story for Solar Siege. Each panel: bg = planet backdrop, art = boss | swarm | ship | squadron | none, speaker, text. Edit freely.

single.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY · PLUTO
single.text: Year 2189. At the frozen edge of the solar system, the listening array on Pluto picks up a signal no one has ever heard before.

single.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY · PLUTO
single.text: It isn't a message. It's a fleet. Something called EREBUS, the Void Sovereign, has woken in the dark, and its swarm is falling toward the Sun.

single.speaker: SOLAR COMMAND
single.text: The swarm strikes where we are weakest. Mercury's solar foundries go dark in a single night. One by one, the outposts stop answering.

single.speaker: SOLAR COMMAND
single.text: Every fleet in the system is scattered or gone. Every fleet but one: the AURORA, our last interceptor still fuelled and armed. Its pilot is you.

single.speaker: SOLAR COMMAND
single.text: Start at Mercury. Drive the swarm back, world by world, all the way out to Pluto, and end Erebus where it began. Good luck, pilot.

multi.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY · PLUTO
multi.text: Year 2189. At the frozen edge of the solar system, the listening array on Pluto picks up a signal no one has ever heard before.

multi.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY · PLUTO
multi.text: It isn't a message. It's a fleet. Something called EREBUS, the Void Sovereign, has woken in the dark, and its swarm is falling toward the Sun.

multi.speaker: SOLAR COMMAND
multi.text: No single pilot can turn back a swarm this size. So Solar Command calls up AURORA SQUADRON: up to four interceptors, flying wing to wing.

multi.speaker: SOLAR COMMAND
multi.text: Watch each other's backs and share the power cores. If a wingmate goes down for good, grab an Extra Ship and bring them back into the fight.

multi.speaker: SOLAR COMMAND
multi.text: Squadron, launch. Mercury first, Pluto last. Erebus never gets to see the Sun.

victory_single: Erebus falls silent, and the swarm scatters into the dark.
Nine worlds, one pilot. The Aurora turns for home.
victory_multi: Erebus falls silent, and the swarm scatters into the dark.
Aurora Squadron flies home in formation. The Sun still shines.
